chunks.embeddingText: Table ApprovePO. Domain: Purchase order (PO) approval. Purpose: tracks each approver assignment on a purchase order for the standard (non-HOD) approval queue used by the PO approval portal. Columns: PoNo (PO number), ApprovalName (approver username), status (Pending, Approved, Approved by user, Rejected), PODate, ApprovalDate, TransId (unique row id). Joins: ApprovePO.PoNo = PurchasePayment.PurchaseCode = Vw_PurchaseOrder.PurchaseCode; ApprovalName = POAllocation.username. Synonyms: pending PO, purchase order approval, PO waiting, standard PO queue. Filter pending with status = 'Pending'. For approved counts use status LIKE 'Approved%'.

Table ApprovePOHOD. Domain: Purchase order HOD approval. Purpose: HOD authority purchase order approval assignments; portal unions this with ApprovePO for pending POs. Columns: PoNo, ApprovalName, status (Pending/Approved/Rejected), PODate, ApprovalDate, transid. Joins: PoNo = PurchasePayment.PurchaseCode = Vw_PurchaseOrder.PurchaseCode. Synonyms: HOD PO approval, head of department PO pending, ApprovePOHOD. Pending filter: status = 'Pending'.

Table ApproveWorkOrder. Domain: Work order (WO) approval. Purpose: approval assignments for work orders; PoNo is the work order code. Columns: PoNo, ApprovalName, status (Pending/Approved by user/Rejected), PODate, ApprovalDate, Transid. Joins: ApproveWorkOrder.PoNo = PurchasePayment.PurchaseCode for TotalAmount and CompanyName. Synonyms: pending work order, WO approval, job work order. Pending filter: status = 'Pending'.

Table ApproveIndent. Domain: Indent / purchase requisition approval. Purpose: approver assignments on indents. Columns: IndentNo (parent indent), IndentSubCode (line code), ApprovalName, Status (Pending/Approved/Rejected), IndentDate, ApprovalDate, transId. Critical joins: IndentSubCode = ItemInfo.code; IndentNo = Vw_StoreDeptt.Expr1. Do not join ItemInfo.code to IndentNo. Synonyms: pending indent, purchase requisition, store indent approval. Pending filter: Status = 'Pending'.

Table PurchasePayment. Domain: PO and work-order header commercial data. Purpose: TotalAmount, CompanyName, Currency, delivery and payment terms for a PurchaseCode. Not bill/vendor payment requests (those are BillPayment*). Columns include PurchaseCode (PK), TotalAmount, CompanyName, Currency, LoginName, TypeOfPO, DepttName, deliverydate, Payment terms text, PoSignal, taxes/discounts. Joins: PurchaseCode = ApprovePO.PoNo / ApproveWorkOrder.PoNo / Vw_PurchaseOrder.PurchaseCode / FinalQuotation.PurchaseCode. Synonyms: PO amount, PO header total, purchase order value.

View Vw_PurchaseOrder. Domain: Purchase order line and vendor details. Purpose: display PO items, FirmName vendor, qty, rate, GST; used by portal PO details. Key columns: PurchaseCode, FirmName, ItemDesc, ItemCode, Qty, Rate, Total, PendingQty, DepttName, CompanyName, Currency, deliverydate, VendorCode, hsncode, tax fields. Join: PurchaseCode = ApprovePO.PoNo = PurchasePayment.PurchaseCode. Synonyms: PO details, PO line items, vendor name on PO. Not for approval status — use ApprovePO.

Table FinalQuotation. Domain: PO quotation / ordered lines. Purpose: item rates and quantities for a PurchaseCode used in PO documents. Columns: PurchaseCode, FirmName, ItemCode, ItemDesc, Qty, Rate, Discount, Total, Unit, StoreCode, SubCode, HSNCODE, GST percents, transid. Join on PurchaseCode to PurchasePayment and Vw_PurchaseOrder. Synonyms: final quotation, PO quote lines. Prefer Vw_PurchaseOrder for general PO detail questions.

Table POAllocation. Domain: PO approval authority mapping. Purpose: username to CompanyName, Deptt, authority level, POAmount/ItemAmount/PartyAmount limits. Columns: username, CompanyName, POAmount, ItemAmount, PartyAmount, NewVendor, NewItem, Deptt, srno, authority. Join username to ApprovePO.ApprovalName / ApproveWorkOrder.ApprovalName. Synonyms: PO approver allocation, authority limits, who can approve. Table name may appear as poallocation in older SQL.

Table BillPaymentHODApproval. Domain: Bill payment approval. Purpose: pending/approved payment request assignments for approvers; main pending-payments table in the portal. Columns: paymentNo (join key), BillNo, MRNo, PartyName (vendor), PaymentAmount, PaymentDate, LoginName (requester), ApprovalName, Status (Pending/Approved/Rejected), ApprovalDate, Comment, transId. Join: paymentNo = BillPaymentEntry.PaymentNo. Synonyms: pending payment, bill payment approval, vendor payment request, PRQ. Pending filter: Status = 'Pending'.

Table BillPaymentEntry. Domain: Bill payment request details. Purpose: company, vendor, bill, MRN, amounts, bank, UTR, isPaid for a PaymentNo. Columns: PaymentNo, CompanyName, VendorName, BillNo, BillDate, MRNno (join to StoreInwardsPayment.MRNo / material receipt number), MRNDate, BillAmount, PaymentAmount, PaymentDate, status, UTRno, isPaid, IsCancel. PREFERRED for 'payment raised against MRN X / how much' => SELECT PaymentNo, MRNno, BillNo, PaymentAmount, BillAmount, status, isPaid FROM BillPaymentEntry WHERE MRNno = 'RM 269'. Join PaymentNo = BillPaymentHODApproval.paymentNo. Synonyms: payment details, bill payment entry, UTR, vendor bill, payment against material receipt. Pending approver queue is primarily BillPaymentHODApproval.

Table BillPaymentEntryApproval. Domain: Bill payment approval history. Purpose: historical approval rows with ApprovalName, ApprovalDate, comment, status for a PaymentNo; used by portal payment history API. Join PaymentNo to BillPaymentEntry and BillPaymentHODApproval.paymentNo. Synonyms: payment approval history, payment comments, who approved payment.

Table BillPaymentApprovalAllocation. Domain: Payment approver allocation. Purpose: ApprovalName mapped to CompanyName, Deptt, authority, ishod for bill payment routing. Join ApprovalName to BillPaymentHODApproval.ApprovalName. Synonyms: payment approver allocation, payment authority matrix.

Table ItemInfo. Domain: Indent line items. Purpose: itemcode, itemdesc, Qty, Unit, stock for indent lines. Critical: code equals ApproveIndent.IndentSubCode (line), not IndentNo (parent). Example IndentNo PIL/22-23/RWM00019 with IndentSubCode PIL/22-23/RWM00019/01. Synonyms: indent items, requisition lines, ItemInfo.

View Vw_StoreDeptt (also referenced as vw_storedeptt). Domain: Indent details. Purpose: portal indent detail lines. Expr1 = parent IndentNo; code = IndentSubCode line. Columns: Expr1, code, itemcode, itemdesc, Qty, Unit, Purpose, ReqDepartment, CompanyName, Deptt, IndentSignal, rates, BrandName. Join Expr1 to ApproveIndent.IndentNo; code to ItemInfo.code. Synonyms: indent details, indent items, store indent view.

Table FactoryInfo. Domain: Ledger / company master. Purpose: companies and factories for accounting and ledger summary. Columns: Name (company name), SrNo (company id), GroupName (group), Address, NewGSTNo (company GSTIN), GST (legacy), PermanentAccountNo (company PAN — NOT named PANNo; FactoryInfo has no PANNo column), LedgerOpeningDate, IndentCode, GroupTag. Join: FactoryInfo.Name = LedgerMaster.CompanyName. Synonyms: company list, factory list, unit master, company GST, company PAN, company group. For company GST/PAN questions select only from FactoryInfo using NewGSTNo and PermanentAccountNo.

Table LedgerMaster (also queried as ledgermaster). Domain: Ledger / chart of accounts. Purpose: party, vendor, bank and GL ledger master per CompanyName. Columns: CompanyName, LedgerName, Under (parent account/ledger GROUP — use DISTINCT Under for ledger groups; never empty LedgerGroupMaster), Openingbalance (opening balance — use for opening-balance questions), PendingBalance (pending/outstanding — use for pending balance questions; LedgerOpeningBalance table is EMPTY do not query it), Category, MainCategory, GSTNo, NewGSTNo, PANNo (ledger/party PAN only — company PAN is FactoryInfo.PermanentAccountNo), BankAccNo, BankName, IFSCCode, PaymentTerms, email, ContactNo, MSMENumber, LVendorCode, IsHold. Join CompanyName = FactoryInfo.Name. Synonyms: ledger list, party master, opening balance, pending balance, ledger outstanding, LedgerOpeningBalance (redirect here), ledger groups, account groups. For pending/opening bills/balances: SELECT LedgerName, Openingbalance, PendingBalance FROM LedgerMaster WHERE CompanyName = .... Do not use for full voucher/ledger statement SP. Avoid vw_LedgerSummary.

Table CommonLedgerMaster. Domain: Ledger. Purpose: common/shared ledger master similar to LedgerMaster with CompanyName, LedgerName, Under, balances, GST/PAN/bank, LSTATUS. Prefer LedgerMaster for normal portal ledger questions. Synonyms: common ledger master, shared chart of accounts.

Table StoreInwardsPayment. Domain: MRN / store inward header. Purpose: MRNo, SrNo, CompanyName (receiving company), PartyName/SupplierName (VENDOR only — e.g. Plastene Polyfilms Ltd-Purchase), BillNo, BillDate (NO MRDate column), BillAMount, ChallanNo, Gate_Inward_No, PONo, IndentNo. Join SrNo to StoreInwards; MRNo to BillPaymentEntry.MRNno. Synonyms: MRN, material receipt, store inward, GRN, goods receipt, find by bill number. Prefer Vw_StoreInwards for combined questions.

Table StoreInwards. Domain: MRN / store inward line items. Purpose: ItemCode, ItemName, RecdQty, AcceptedQty, OrderQty, PendingQty, Rate, Amount, PONo per SrNo. Join SrNo to StoreInwardsPayment for MRNo/party/bill. Large table — use TOP 50. Synonyms: MRN items, received materials, store inward lines.

View Vw_StoreInwards. Domain: MRN / store inward combined details. Preferred view for material receipt questions. Columns: SrNo, MRNo, PONo, CompanyName (receiving company), PartyName (VENDOR — e.g. Plastene Polyfilms Ltd-Purchase is a PartyName), BillNo, BillDate, GateInwardDate, SysDate, ItemName, ItemCode, RecdQty, AcceptedQty, OrderQty, PendingQty, Rate, Amount, Deptt, IndentNo, GateInwardNo, VendorGST, MRNStatus, LoginName. NO column MRDate — use BillDate/GateInwardDate/SysDate. Synonyms: goods receipt, GRN, material received, receipts by bill number. Example: Find receipts linked to bill number PPL/D/540 => WHERE BillNo = 'PPL/D/540' on THIS view (not BillPaymentEntry). Example: receipts for Plastene Polyfilms Ltd-Purchase => WHERE PartyName = '...'. Example: for company Oswal Extrusion Limited pending qty => CompanyName + PendingQty > 0. Always TOP 50.

View vw_MRNList. Domain: MRN listing. Purpose: list material receipts with CompanyName (receiving company), Partyname (vendor only), MRNDate (spelled MRNDate — never invent MRDate), MRno, BillNo, item quantities, GateInwardNo. Synonyms: MRN list, material receipt list, browse MRNs, recent goods receipts. For company filter use CompanyName; for vendor like Plastene Polyfilms Ltd-Purchase use Partyname. Use TOP 50. Column MRno is the MRN number.

View vw_MRNToBillPayment. Domain: MRN linked to bill payment. Purpose: connect material receipt MRno to PaymentNo, PaymentAmount, UTRno, BillNo, Partyname. CRITICAL: view is LINE grain — many rows have NULL PaymentNo even when payments exist for that MRN. For 'was payment raised against MRN RM 269 and for how much' prefer BillPaymentEntry WHERE MRNno = 'RM 269'. If using this view: SELECT DISTINCT PaymentNo, PaymentAmount WHERE MRno = 'RM 269' AND PaymentNo IS NOT NULL. Never treat a NULL PaymentNo row as proof of no payment. Synonyms: payment against MRN, was MRN paid, UTR for MRN, PRQ for material receipt. Bracket spaced columns: [Challan Date], [Basic Amount], [MRN User].
